title: Armor Stand Arms
description: Armor stands have arms by default!
body: ![minecraft datapack armor stand arms mod auto arms armor stand arm](https://jodeks-datapacks.codeberg.page/assets/titles/armor_stand_arms.png) [![jodeks discord - discord badge - pixel badge - pixel discord badge - jodeks datapacks - datapacks discord](https://jodeks-datapacks.codeberg.page/assets/badges/Discord.png)](https://discord.gg/z2n3qTzQY6)   [![datapacks jodek youtube](https://jodeks-datapacks.codeberg.page/assets/badges/YouTube.png)](https://www.youtube.com/@jodek)   [![armor stand arms minecraft datapack codeberg issues](https://jodeks-datapacks.codeberg.page/assets/badges/CB_Issues.png)](https://codeberg.org/jodeks-datapacks/armor-stand-arms/issues/)   [![jodeks datapacks kofi - jodek kofi - minecraft datapack kofi donation](https://jodeks-datapacks.codeberg.page/assets/badges/Kofi.png)](https://ko-fi.com/jodek) ## Features **1.** Automatically adds arms to armor stands when placed **2.** [1.21+] Shift + right click an armor stand to show / hide the arms **3.** [1.21.6+] Settings with `/trigger armor_stand_arms.config` **Remove all arms** ``` /function armor_stand_arms:app/arms/remove_all ``` **Show all arms** ``` /function armor_stand_arms:app/arms/show_all ``` ## Showcase     [![jodek datapack suggestions](https://jodeks-datapacks.codeberg.page/assets/badges/new_datapack_suggestion.png?v=3)](https://codeberg.org/jodeks-datapacks/.profile/issues/new?template=.forgejo%2fISSUE_TEMPLATE%2fdatapack_request.yaml) ## Below 1.21 Features If you want to **remove the arms** from **only one armor stand** run: ``` /trigger remove_arms ``` and to **enable** them again run ``` /trigger show_arms ``` For that to work without complications: Go as near as you can to the armor stand and use /trigger
